name: Eraser
tagline: Eraser is a diagramming and documentation tool purpose-built for software engineers. It generates architecture diagrams, sequence diagrams, entity-relationship diagrams, and flowcharts from code or text descriptions using AI. Engineering teams use it to create and maintain technical documentation alongside code.
